name: form
title: Form
description: A <form> laid out as a column of Fields and submitted through TanStack Form: no native validation, handleSubmit on submit, focus on the first invalid field.
usage: Create the form with useForm from @tanstack/react-form (defaultValues, validators, onSubmit), pass it as form, and render each field with form.Field and a Field inside. For a native-like flow use validationLogic: revalidateLogic({ mode: "submit", modeAfterSubmission: "change" }); for per-field checks use validators.onBlur. Show the submit state with form.Subscribe and Button's loading. Without form, Form is only a styled <form>.

props.name: form
props.description: The TanStack Form instance: submitting calls form.handleSubmit() and focuses the first control whose field has errors.

props.name: noValidate
props.description: Turns off the browser's validation; true by default when form is set, since TanStack Form validates.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Called first on submit; with form, the native submission is then prevented.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the form (it becomes a form landmark) when no heading labels it through aria-labelledby.

props.name: render
props.description: Base UI render prop: render another element with the form's props.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged after the component's own.

slots.name: root
slots.description: The form, a column with space.stack.md between fields; data-slot="form".

accessibility: Renders a native <form>, so Enter in a text field submits it; keep a type="submit" Button in it.
After a failed submit, focus moves to the first invalid control in document order, and its FieldError is read through aria-describedby.
Name the form with aria-label or aria-labelledby when the page has more than one.
Errors appear on submit and then follow each change (revalidateLogic) or on blur, never on the first keystroke of an untouched field.
Announce the outcome of a submission in a role="status" region; the submit Button's loading sets aria-busy.
